item.title: World Toilet Day is a funny idea with a serious goal: A world awash in toilets
item.description: Yahoo for the loo! November 19 marks the 25th anniversary of World Toilet Day. The theme this year: "Sanitation and Gender Equality: Safe Toilets, Equal Futures."

item.description: As the emergency response to the flood ends, aid workers turn to the hard work of rebuilding communities that lost everything. Many of those workers lost everything, too.

item.title: As overdose deaths fall, White House makes misleading claims about who deserves credit
item.description: In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The off-and-on switch for U.S. aid leads to a cliffhanger for Zambia and Zimbabwe
item.description: After dismantling the United States Agency for International Development, the Trump administration is restarting foreign aid. In Zambia and Zimbabwe, there are different approaches but similar worries.

item.title: Public health expert reacts to latest measles milestone
item.description: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dr. Ashish Jha, senior fellow at Harvard's Belfer Center and former White House coronavirus czar, about the news that the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status.

item.title: U.S. officially loses its measles elimination status
item.description: The Pan American Health Organization announced that measles is no longer considered eliminated in the U.S. It's classified as endemic now because a strain has lingered in the U.S. for over a year.
item.content:encoded: The Pan American Health Organization announced that measles is no longer considered eliminated in the U.S. It's classified as endemic now because a strain has lingered in the U.S. for over a year.

item.title: Health organization to announce that the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status
item.description: The Pan American Health Organization is expected to announce that measles is no longer eliminated in the U.S. Record cases, lower vaccination rates and uncontained outbreaks led to the resurgence.

item.title: Why sleep matters when it comes to weight gain and loss
item.description: Sleep can have a powerful impact on weight. Research shows it can affect appetite. There is also a two-way relationship between sleep quality and diet.
